• An excellent resource for developing understanding of and proficiency with the content and skills assessed in this
question is Vectors: A Curriculum Module for AP®
Calculus BC, by Nancy Stephenson. This module was published
in 2010 and is still highly valued today for its clear explanations and excellent practice problems. Days 4-6 of this
module are especially relevant to this question.
